title: Fire Emblem Fates
subtitle: Intelligent Systems · Nintendo 3DS
summary: Fire Emblem Fates is Intelligent Systems' tactical role-playing game for Nintendo 3DS. Corrin was born in Hoshido and raised by the royal family of Nohr. When the two kingdoms go to war, choosing a side means abandoning people who also consider Corrin their sibling. Birthright and Conquest follow those opposing allegiances, while Revelation offers a third route. body: Fire Emblem Fates is Intelligent Systems' tactical role-playing game for Nintendo 3DS. Corrin was born in Hoshido and raised by the royal family of Nohr. When the two kingdoms go to war, choosing a side means abandoning people who also consider Corrin their sibling. Birthright and Conquest follow those opposing allegiances, while Revelation offers a third route. The choice reaches beyond the story: each campaign provides different companions, maps and conditions for developing the army that must carry it through the conflict.

Infantry, mounted units and flying fighters move across a grid, with terrain and weapon matchups shaping their chances. Adjacent allies can support an attack; pairing them instead provides protection and other advantages. Royal characters can use Dragon Veins to alter parts of a map, opening or closing routes at an important moment. A strong unit still needs a safe position when the enemy turn begins. The task is to arrange the whole army so that one successful attack does not leave its author surrounded.

Birthright allows opportunities to earn additional experience and money, while Conquest makes the supplies gained from its main battles particularly valuable. Revelation combines extra training opportunities with more elaborate battlefield devices. Between missions, My Castle provides shops and conversations that develop the group. Classic mode preserves the series' permanent deaths; Casual brings defeated allies back after battle. The versions let the same central dilemma support markedly different experiences, from a more forgiving introduction to a campaign that asks for careful use of a limited army.
story_headings: A family on either side of the border
One turn can decide the next battle
